meta.source: yfinance daily closes (TIP, HYG, SPY, GLD, SLV), fresh each run
method_notes: TIP/HYG gates compare the last close with the 50-day mean (≈ the weekly 10-bar mean in alpha_mechanics).
GSR = GLD/SLV; 'falling' = today below the value 55 trading days ago.
If any component is unavailable it is excluded from the denominator and the stance says so.

rule: ≥2/4 → FULL risk-on · ≤1/4 → HALF WEIGHT (Q4 rules, q4-action-plan-2026-10-11 §4)
